Your Meals
This is more than a recipe book. By saving Grandma’s secret family recipes right next to those 10 minute meals you can throw together, Spork Fed allows you to create a meal plan that actually matches your life.

Your Choices
Meal planning can benefit anyone, but sometimes it is too overwhelming. With Spork Fed you only need to save the meal’s name, give it a category, and say how often you prefer the meal.  Spork Fed will create a suggested menu for you based on these alone. Planning your week is as simple as choosing the categories that sound yummy and clicking Go.

Your Plan
Most people aren’t robots and their weeks include nights to get take-out or nights they will eat leftovers. Other times you have no idea what sounds good. Some nights everything falls apart and you need to call an audible. No worries, Spork Fed has options for these too. 

Your List
Once you have a plan, you still have to get the groceries. Spork Fed makes that easy by pulling in all the ingredients you have saved with your meals that you planned. All you need to do is add any additional items that need picked up at the store and you are ready to go. Once at the store, use the app to mark off the items as you go.

Made Simple
If the suggested plan doesn’t include that favorite meal you wanted to have on Tuesday, a simple swipe and replace is all it takes to update the meal plan.

If Spork Fed suggested Spaghetti on Wednesday, but you want to plan a different type of pasta. A simple swipe and shuffle will suggest the next best pasta option in your recipes.

If Thursday comes and your family decides to order Pizza instead of making the Tacos you had planned, swipe to cancel the planned meal or leave it there for tomorrow.

Live Your Plan
The only thing left to do is mark the days complete as you go.  Spork Fed stays smart by keeping track of how often you want a meal to be suggested in your meal plan and the last day you completed this meal. This will assure that next month that favorite recipe will roll back around when you plan your menu.
